Package com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents

Class EventsRepository

java.lang.Object
com.example.lotterize.ui.addEvents.EventsRepository
public class EventsRepository extends Object
This repository responsible for reading Event objects from Firestore.

This class is implemented as a simple singleton so that production code and tests can share a single entry point for event-related Firestore access. setInstance(EventsRepository) can be used to inject a mock implementation in ui tests.

    • listenToEvents

      public ListenerRegistration listenToEvents(String ownerId, EventsRepository.MyEventsCallback callback)
      This starts listening for all events owned by a specific user. The query filters the events collection by ownerId, converts each matching document to an Event via Event.addEventDetailsFromSnapShot(DocumentSnapshot), and returns the resulting list to EventsRepository.MyEventsCallback.onEvents(ArrayList).
      Parameters:
      ownerId - the user ID of the event owner whose events should be observed
      callback - callback to receive updates and errors

    • listenToEventById

      public ListenerRegistration listenToEventById(String eventId, EventsRepository.EventsDetailCallback callback)
      This starts listening for changes to a single event document by its ID. Whenever the document changes, this method attempts to parse it into an Event using Event.addEventDetailsFromSnapShot(DocumentSnapshot) and invokes EventsRepository.EventsDetailCallback.onEvents(Event, DocumentSnapshot, Exception).
      Parameters:
      eventId - the ID of the event document in the events collection
      callback - callback to receive the event details or errors
      Returns:
      a
      invalid reference 
      ListenerRegistration
      that can be used to stop listening (via
      invalid reference
